name: _cn
summary: Minimal TanStack Start starter for publishing a shadcn-compatible component registry with docs and previews.
description: An intentionally minimal TanStack Start + Vite+ starter template for publishing a shadcn-compatible registry without writing the docs site or registry plumbing: typed registry authoring, MDX docs under /docs, live preview pages with syntax-highlighted source, schema validation against shadcn's schemas, and server routes that serve the registry index and item JSON with dynamic search. Also generates llms.txt and llms-full.txt and supports markdown content negotiation for AI clients.
contains: typed registry authoring under registry/ with registry/config.ts
live preview plus syntax-highlighted source for every registry item
registry index JSON at /registry.json and /r paths with dynamic search (q, type, limit, offset)
generates /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt and serves markdown to AI clients
scripts to scaffold items (new.ts) and validate metadata (doctor.ts)
installable agent skill for registry authoring
deploys to Vercel as a platform-agnostic Nitro server
